title: ecbolium sphaerospermum
intro: Ecbolium sphaerospermum, commonly known as Globe-headed Ecbolium or Globe-headed Ecbolium, is a plant species in the family Acanthaceae. It is used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties that can aid in the treatment of various health conditions such as wounds, infections, and oxidative stress.
